page_title: UDI 3-0 EMP | Udinese v Empoli 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing.

90+4' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Marco Silvestri makes a great save to deny his effort directed under the crossbar. The linesman makes the right call and Udinese will have a corner.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' 3 - 0 Goal! Martin Payero swings the ball deep into the box and finds Florian Thauvin (Udinese) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the roof of the net. 3:0.
89' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
86' Udinese take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing. The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner.

86' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
85' Substitution. Ismael Konate (Empoli) has come on for Liam Henderson.
85' It's time for a substitution. Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) comes on in place of Liberato Cacace.
84' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 11:17.
81' Here is a change. Sandi Lovric is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Iker Bravo (Udinese).
81' Here comes a substitution. Simone Pafundi (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Lorenzo Lucca.
79' The move breaks down when Martin Payero (Udinese) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.

78' A short pass finds Christian Kouame (Empoli). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
77' A long-range free kick is awarded to Empoli.
75' That will be all from Youssef Maleh who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli).
75' Substitution. Emmanuel Gyasi will be replaced by Junior Sambia (Empoli).
74' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp will be replaced by Alexis Sanchez (Udinese).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rui Modesto (Udinese) replaces Kingsley Ehizibue.

73' What a miss! Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
70' Udinese are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is behind the touchline and Udinese will take a throw-in.
68' 59:41 – the ratio of ball possession.
65' 2 - 0 Goal! Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 2:0.

65' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Marco Silvestri makes a great save to stop his effort.
64' The game has come to an end for Arthur Atta. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Martin Payero (Udinese).
63' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
63' Empoli are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Now Empoli have a corner.
62' Substitution. Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lorenzo Colombo walks off.

61' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Razvan Sava guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) picks up the rebound and shoots. The goalkeeper was ready and denies his effort with a fine save.
61' The ball goes out of play. Empoli are awarded a corner kick.

60' Post! Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
59' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is about to take a corner kick.

59' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Udinese win a corner kick.
56' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
54' Empoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

54' Liam Henderson (Empoli) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Empoli will take a corner.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing.
52' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Udinese.
51' Udinese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
49' PENALTY APPEAL after Florian Thauvin (Udinese) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
47' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Daniele Doveri saw the whole situation.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Empoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' The free kick from long range, taken by Empoli, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Empoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
44' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. It's a free kick to Empoli in a dangerous position.
43' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
42' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
40' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:7.
37' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

37' Udinese show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The linesman points to the corner flag, Udinese are going to take it.

33' The cross fools the defence and leaves Christian Kouame (Empoli) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
32' Udinese showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
29' It looks like Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Doveri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

27' Udinese slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
26' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.

25' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
24' Empoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

23' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Empoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' Udinese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

21' Udinese are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Udinese force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
19' 1 - 0 Goal! Arthur Atta takes aim and his effort deflects off Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) to beat the goalkeeper. 1:0.
19' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

19' Superb touch by Sandi Lovric (Udinese) as he receives a precise pass inside the box. He finds the keeper prepared as he unleashes his shot to the left side of the goal. Wonderful save! The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Udinese.
17' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Udinese.
15' Udinese showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.

12' Golden chance! Christian Kouame (Empoli) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

11' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Florian Thauvin (Udinese) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Marco Silvestri easily catches the ball.
10' Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.

8' That was a nice football moment. Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Razvan Sava guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
7' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
6' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
3' Udinese are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Udinese will take the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri was nominated as the referee for this game.
